newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Tanks move on to streets of Tirana.
newsitem.headline: Tanks move on to streets of Tirana.

text.p: Tanks moved on to the streets of Tirana late on Thursday night in an apparent attempt to stem mounting unrest gripping Albania, witnesses said.
At least two tanks could be seen deploying in the centre of the Albanian capital, on a main boulevard where key government buildings are located.
Earlier, opposition political party leaders said Albanian President Sali Berisha had told them he was going to send in the tanks "to protect the main state institutions".
Their arrival coincided with mounting lawlessness in Albania, where rebels have raided army barracks and looted weapons.
The crackle of small arms fire, as insurgents discharged their weapons into the air, could be heard in Tirana against a backdrop of the roar of tank engines.
